### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

There are three things that BelWo has helped to contribute to impact our business in a positive way.

## Welcome to CCM Supply

We are your trusted partner in providing high-quality metalworking services for various industrial
applications. At CCM Supply, we are committed to delivering exceptional craftsmanship and materials
tailored to meet the specific needs of our clients. With a dedicated team and extensive experience,
we focus on producing top-quality metal products and offering superior service.

Our shop features a diverse range of metalworking capabilities, carefully managed to ensure the
highest standards of precision and excellence. Whether you're involved in manufacturing or another
industry, we are here to support your projects with expertise and reliability.

Discover why so many choose us as their go-to metal shop. Reach out today to learn more about our
services, request information, or discuss your project needs. Experience the difference with us!

## About Us

CCM Supply was established to be a trusted partner in providing high-quality metalworking services,
specializing in hard-to-find alloys. Our goal is to help our customers navigate the supply chain
challenges that have arisen in recent years. By focusing on reliability and precision, we ensure
that our clients receive the expertly crafted metal components required to support critical sectors
such as Aerospace, Defense, and beyond.

We understand the unique demands of these industries and strive to provide solutions that keep
operations running smoothly and efficiently. From meeting tight deadlines to accommodating
specialized requests, we are committed to being a dependable resource for our partners.

At CCM Supply, we take pride in our team of experienced professionals and skilled craftsmen. With
over 20 years of experience, our team possesses extensive metallurgical knowledge and expertise in
handling exotic materials, precise configurations, and meticulous metal cutting and finishing. We
offer a dependable, full-service solution for customers who value high-quality support and results.

## Our Products

Discover our wide range of metal products, including steel, aluminum, copper, and more, suitable for
all your industrial needs. Contact us today to talk to a team member to find out more!

Take your team — and your projects — to the next level with CMAA membership. From cutting-edge
training and certifications to valuable networking and business development opportunities, CMAA

member today and start building smarter.

#### [ Why Join CMAA? ][112]

## We Set the Standard

Easy access to a wide variety of services and resources that will improve your personal performance,
enhance your firm’s capabilities, and brighten the outlook of the entire construction management
profession. CMAA is more than the sum of all these elements though. Like any association, what CMAA
is and what CMAA does largely depends on you. Join CMAA today, and set yourself on the path to a
brighter future.

[Become a CMAA Member][113]

#### [ For Organizations ][114]

At CMAA, you’ll find plenty of ways to get involved. Build your teams, your business, and
your profession. As a corporate member of CMAA, your organization will be clearly associated with
the highest standards and the most responsive, accountable service in the industry. Corporate
members have access to a wide range of technical and leadership training programs, business
development opportunities, and a library of resources which stay current on industry best practices.
Become an active member of CMAA today.

#### [ For Individuals ][115]

CMAA welcomes construction industry professionals from all over the globe. Membership provides a
“go-to” resource for technical and leadership training, networking, and professional development
which in turn, will ensure that you are staying current on industry best practices to complete
projects on-time and on-budget. Members have access to benefits both at the national and the chapter
level. Join us, and develop new relationships at every turn.

## Raise Your CM Career Ceiling to New Heights

[logo]

#### **Become a Certified Construction Manager (CCM)**

The Certified Construction Manager (CCM) is the “gold standard” in personnel credentials for the
Construction Management profession. It is the only CM certification accredited by the American
National Standards Institute (ANSI) National Accreditation Board (ANAB) under the International
Organization for  Standardization’s ISO-17024 standard.

[Find a CCM for your project][129]

**[CACM Logo]**

###  

#### **Become a Certified Associate Construction Manager (CACM)**

The Certified Associate Construction Manager (CACM) recognizes professionals who have chosen a
career in construction management and voluntarily met the prescribed criteria of the construction
management certification program with regards to formal education, field experience, and
demonstrated capability and understanding of CMAA’s Standards of Practice.

#### [Learn more][130]

[Construction Manager in Training logo]

#### **Become a Construction Manager-in-Training (CMIT)**

The CMIT is a self-paced certificate program that helps aspiring CM professionals launch and develop
a successful career into the CM industry. The designation demonstrates competence in the practice of
CM early in an individual’s career. Those who have earned their CMIT are able to demonstrate their
investment in the industry as well as in their own professional development.

[Learn more][131]

## Established in 1982, CMAA sets the standard for managing capital construction projects.
* [ Why Join CMAA? ][109]

#### [ Why Join CMAA? ][112]

## We Set the Standard

Easy access to a wide variety of services and resources that will improve your personal performance,
enhance your firm’s capabilities, and brighten the outlook of the entire construction management
profession. CMAA is more than the sum of all these elements though. Like any association, what CMAA
is and what CMAA does largely depends on you. Join CMAA today, and set yourself on the path to a
brighter future.

[Become a CMAA Member][113]

#### [ For Organizations ][114]

At CMAA, you’ll find plenty of ways to get involved. Build your teams, your business, and
your profession. As a corporate member of CMAA, your organization will be clearly associated with
the highest standards and the most responsive, accountable service in the industry. Corporate
members have access to a wide range of technical and leadership training programs, business
development opportunities, and a library of resources which stay current on industry best practices.
Become an active member of CMAA today.

#### [ For Individuals ][115]

CMAA welcomes construction industry professionals from all over the globe. Membership provides a
“go-to” resource for technical and leadership training, networking, and professional development
which in turn, will ensure that you are staying current on industry best practices to complete
projects on-time and on-budget. Members have access to benefits both at the national and the chapter
level. Join us, and develop new relationships at every turn.

## Raise Your CM Career Ceiling to New Heights

[logo]

#### **Become a Certified Construction Manager (CCM)**

The Certified Construction Manager (CCM) is the “gold standard” in personnel credentials for the
Construction Management profession. It is the only CM certification accredited by the American
National Standards Institute (ANSI) National Accreditation Board (ANAB) under the International
Organization for  Standardization’s ISO-17024 standard.

[Find a CCM for your project][129]

**[CACM Logo]**

###  

#### **Become a Certified Associate Construction Manager (CACM)**

The Certified Associate Construction Manager (CACM) recognizes professionals who have chosen a
career in construction management and voluntarily met the prescribed criteria of the construction
management certification program with regards to formal education, field experience, and
demonstrated capability and understanding of CMAA’s Standards of Practice.

#### [Learn more][130]

[Construction Manager in Training logo]

#### **Become a Construction Manager-in-Training (CMIT)**

The CMIT is a self-paced certificate program that helps aspiring CM professionals launch and develop
a successful career into the CM industry. The designation demonstrates competence in the practice of
CM early in an individual’s career. Those who have earned their CMIT are able to demonstrate their
investment in the industry as well as in their own professional development.

[Learn more][131]

Built for organizations where communication errors are simply not an option.
**Consistent across every channel  ****•****  Built on open standards  ****• **** Maximum
flexibility**

**The Challenge**

##### **What's holding your communications back**

The challenges are familiar. Compart eliminates them at the source.
* **Every change becomes an IT project
  **
* **No visibility across the entire process
  **
* **Compliance is still manual
  **
* **Growth adds complexity
  **
* **Channel silos lead to inconsistent communications
  **
* **Legacy systems slow innovation**

**The Compart Solution**

##### **What our customers gain**
* **Changes in minutes, not months
  **Business users manage content and templates themselves**
  **
* **Complete transparency
  **Every communication fully traceable at every step**
  **
* **Compliance automatically ensured
  **Audit trail, automated approvals, and accessibility – even for legacy documents**
  **
* **Processes scale with your growth
  **One platform for every channel. More volume without more effort**
  **
* **Ready for whatever comes next
  **Open standards and the freedom to evolve – without vendor lock-in

### **30+ Years**

of market experience

### **1.500+ Customers**

worldwide

### **50+ Countries**

with active customer installations

**Our Products**

### **Two Suites. One Mission.**

DocBridge® Communication Suite and DocBridge® Production Suite combine modern Customer
Communications Management (CCM) with powerful Output Management – for less complexity and more
control over your entire customer communications.

DocBridge Communication Suite

### **The CCM platform** for mission-critical customer communications

**Cloud-native  ****• **** AI-powered  ****•  **** No vendor lock-in**
Create, manage, and deliver millions of personalized customer  communications across every channel –
securely and compliantly. Seamlessly integrate with your existing systems to increase operational
efficiency, intelligently automate complex processes, and scale effortlessly as your business grows.

[Discover the CCM platform][54] [Request a demo][55]
DocBridge Production Suite

### **High-performance Output Management** for enterprise-scale production

**Automated  ****•  A****ny format  ****•  C****omplete visibility**
Automate your document production and reliably deliver millions of documents. From document
conversion and quality assurance to omnichannel delivery, the DocBridge® Production Suite
streamlines high-volume production, reduces costs, and gives you complete control over quality and
 performance.

[Explore our products][56]

企业数字化服务

基础设施
通过优阅达云数据应用解决方案，企业可以更从容地应对云上数据挑战：
依托云平台强大的计算、存储和数据库等基础设施技术，企业可以加强海量数据资产管理和潜力挖掘，
达成降本增效的持续发展目标；借助机器学习、人工智能、数据湖、分析及物联网等新兴技术，
企业可以构建更丰富的数字化智能应用，以更快速度焕新业务价值。
数据治理与存储
通过数据编织、数据虚拟化、智能多维数据库、一站式云端指标中台等领先科技，
优阅达可助力企业增强数据架构的可靠性和可用能力，
建立强有力的数据战略和行之有效的数据治理机制，加速业务数据智能连接和分析效率。
数据消费
为应对企业数据消费应用构建过程存在低效、成本高、管理混乱、不安全等问题，
优阅达提供了低代码数据建模、智能数据搜索、自助式数据分析和高质量数据集成等多种创新解决方案，
能够最大限度助力企业打破数据消费壁垒，增强数据驱动业务的核心能力。
AIGC
随着人工智能技术的不断进步，AIGC 能生成更高质量、更多样化、更个性化的内容，
满足企业的各种需求和场景。优阅达 AIGC 解决方案将高效助力企业实现多种智能化应用，
提高生产效率和服务质量，降低成本和错误率，增强企业的竞争力和创新能力。
连接 SaaS
SaaS 应用无需前期投入大量的硬件和软件，在节省企业成本的同时还能帮助其快速实现信息化。 并且，SaaS
应用无需企业配备专业的 IT 人员，也能随时使用最新的数字技术，最大限度满足企业对信息管理的需求。
优阅达提供多种灵活的 SaaS 解决方案，将助力企业降本增效，迈入高效的数字化管理时代。
数据赋能
大数据时代，数据创造力已经成为职场人的必备技能，也是企业数字化转型的关键因素。
优阅达数创学院致力于为组织和个人构建并提升数据创造力，通过不断优化的课程和培训，
为组织和个人在态度、技能、知识等多个层面进行数据以及创造力的持续提升；通过数字化培训赋能业务，
助力职场人提升数据素养，助力企业构建数据生态。

企业数字化服务

基础设施
通过优阅达云数据应用解决方案，企业可以更从容地应对云上数据挑战：
依托云平台强大的计算、存储和数据库等基础设施技术，企业可以加强海量数据资产管理和潜力挖掘，
达成降本增效的持续发展目标；借助机器学习、人工智能、数据湖、分析及物联网等新兴技术，
企业可以构建更丰富的数字化智能应用，以更快速度焕新业务价值。
数据治理与存储
通过数据编织、数据虚拟化、智能多维数据库、一站式云端指标中台等领先科技，
优阅达可助力企业增强数据架构的可靠性和可用能力，
建立强有力的数据战略和行之有效的数据治理机制，加速业务数据智能连接和分析效率。
数据消费
为应对企业数据消费应用构建过程存在低效、成本高、管理混乱、不安全等问题，
优阅达提供了低代码数据建模、智能数据搜索、自助式数据分析和高质量数据集成等多种创新解决方案，
能够最大限度助力企业打破数据消费壁垒，增强数据驱动业务的核心能力。
AIGC
随着人工智能技术的不断进步，AIGC 能生成更高质量、更多样化、更个性化的内容，
满足企业的各种需求和场景。优阅达 AIGC 解决方案将高效助力企业实现多种智能化应用，
提高生产效率和服务质量，降低成本和错误率，增强企业的竞争力和创新能力。
连接 SaaS
SaaS 应用无需前期投入大量的硬件和软件，在节省企业成本的同时还能帮助其快速实现信息化。 并且，SaaS
应用无需企业配备专业的 IT 人员，也能随时使用最新的数字技术，最大限度满足企业对信息管理的需求。
优阅达提供多种灵活的 SaaS 解决方案，将助力企业降本增效，迈入高效的数字化管理时代。
数据赋能
大数据时代，数据创造力已经成为职场人的必备技能，也是企业数字化转型的关键因素。
优阅达数创学院致力于为组织和个人构建并提升数据创造力，通过不断优化的课程和培训，
为组织和个人在态度、技能、知识等多个层面进行数据以及创造力的持续提升；通过数字化培训赋能业务，
助力职场人提升数据素养，助力企业构建数据生态。

At Doctricks, we begin by analyzing your business to discern your Customer Communication needs. We

Our certified CCM consultants seamlessly integrate into your team as developers and technicians. We
specialize in implementing StreamServe, Exstream, and Inspire, upgrading your existing platform, and
enhancing your current solution.

Quadient to efficiently manage and update your customer communications. Our experienced trainers
will work with you to understand your specific needs and tailor the training to meet your goals.

### What are your business goals?

[Business team discussing how to reduce expenses]

Reduce Expenses

Most organizations are providing customers with hard copy documents which are costly for staff to
store, manage, and search for important customer files. Moving towards a digital document strategy
can greatly reduce your overhead costs of physical document management.

[Read more][61]

[Business team discussing how to enhance customer experience]

Enhance the Customer Experience

Deliver personalized, omnichannel communications in your customers channel of choice based on their
preferences. Whether print or digital, one-way or interactive, reach your customers in the channels
they desire and will engage with.

[Read more][62]

[Business team planning how to manage their customer communication]

Business Continuity

Most organizations have well thought out contingency plans for their IT. However, document and
customer communications management systems are often overlooked. Consider what would happen if your
organization suddenly could no longer send out critical documents to your customers.

[Read more][63]

[Product manager looking through the regulatory requirement on a tablet with team member]

Regulatory Compliance

The pressure to offer secure and compliant communications to customers is increasing, due to local
and international regulatory requirements, but meeting these requirements can be overwhelming as
organizations are already stretched to meet day-to-day business requirements.

[Read more][64]

[Business team accessing information through different digital devices]

Document Accessibility

Making content accessible to people with disabilities is that rare opportunity to address an
underserved market, while at the same time complying with mandates that are spurring double digit
increases in lawsuits every year.

[Read more][65]

[Team member accessing digital data on laptop]

Modernization

Most organizations are balancing legacy investments in systems and processes with emerging digital
requirements. Leverage both to provide a modern customer experience through a communications
strategy.

[Read more][66]

inclusion, and social responsibility in the business world.

## Your team has ideas,
## your agents have capabilities,
## HackMD brings them together

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

## Built for the team, open to your agents

Your workspace, where humans collaborate and agents can keep up

#### Write together, think together, ship together

Real-time editing with multiple cursors, comments, version history, and GitHub sync. Everything your
team already counts on, every day.
* [Live editing with multiple cursors][14]
* [Comments & mentions][15]
* [Version history][16]
* [Templates][17]
* [GitHub integration][18]
Every edit, every comment, every revision is tracked and recoverable, so your team's thinking isn't
just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.
[
Explore features][19]

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][20]
* [Embeds][21]
* [Slide mode][22]
* Open-source friendly
When your community has a home base where anyone can show up, share what they know, and start
building with each other, that's when things start to take off. HackMD gives your community a place
to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.
[
See community stories][23]

#### Give your agents the context they need, without the overhead

Every HackMD note is Markdown all the way down, which means your agents can pull context, reference
docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.
* Pull any note as Markdown via REST API or CLI
* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

Already powering over 1M+ API calls
Teams are using HackMD's API to feed their agents context, automate note creation, and keep
documentation in sync.

## Your team has ideas,
## your agents have capabilities,
## HackMD brings them together

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

###### That's where HackMD comes in

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

## Millions build with HackMD's Markdown editor every day

Powering teams around the world, from next-generation startups to established institutions

team already counts on, every day.

just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.
[

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][20]
* [Embeds][21]

* Open-source friendly

to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.

docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.

* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown
Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

## ANNOUNCEMENT · PRODUCT RELEASE

## OpenParser AI Goes Agentic

**A major release from Innovatix Technology Partners marks a new chapter for enterprise knowledge
intelligence.**

We are pleased to announce a major release of OpenParser AI, our agentic knowledge intelligence
platform for document heavy businesses. The release introduces 20+ pre-built Agents that don’t just
answer questions, but complete entire workflows across documents, live databases and web content.
Contract reviews, compliance gap analyses, invoice audits, executive summaries; all delivered as
finished outputs, all cited, all auditable. The release also adds live connectors to Google Drive,
Microsoft SharePoint and SQL databases, native website content sources, expanded document format
support, and Bring Your Own LLM that allows customers to power their Agents with models from OpenAI,
Anthropic, Google or other supported providers.

This is the biggest step forward for OpenParser since launch, and a defining moment for how we
believe enterprise AI should work.

[ Explore the new OpenParser AI ][84]

## Evolving expertise. New game. Greater possibilities.

## We're now Innovatix

After 30+ years as Macrosoft, we’ve rebranded as Innovatix-a
name that better reflects who we are and what we do.
Innovatix signals where we’re headed and how we work: with smart technology, fresh thinking, and a
relentless focus on solving the challenges that hold businesses back. Our core belief is that
innovation should serve a goal, and every solution we deliver is aligned with what our clients need
most.
We’re excited for what’s ahead—let’s talk about how innovation can move your business forward.

## Solutions Built for Your Industry

Every industry manages information differently. Regulations, workflows, and risk profiles vary, and
generic document management systems lose critical context. M-Files connects documents to the
business context around them, so information reflects how your industry actually works.

Using metadata-driven architecture, documents are automatically classified and governed based on
industry requirements. Built-in governance enforces compliance and retention policies, while
configurable workflows support project-driven, compliance-intensive, and client-focused work. With
trusted context always in place, information stays accurate, secure, and audit-ready as your
business grows.

Macrosoft is a trusted implementation partner for Quadient and OpenText, boasting a team of over 125
certified professionals across various modules to deliver best-in-class Customer Communications
Management (CCM) solutions. Our expertise empowers businesses to streamline personalized
communications, significantly enhancing client engagement and customer satisfaction. We offer
comprehensive services that include migrating from legacy systems, such as Autograph, DOC1,
DocuMerge, Calligo, Papyrus, COBOL, and CSF, to Quadient Inspire and OpenText Exstream.
Additionally, we provide software implementation and licensing support, along with flexible delivery
models tailored to client needs—ranging from managed teams and project-based engagements to
dedicated resources and implementation partnerships. Our commitment is to transform how businesses
communicate, ensuring that their messaging resonates with the right audience while upholding
compliance and security standards.

[Explore More][18]

## ********[Ai, Data & Emerging Technologies][19]********

Agentic AI, to elevate business operations. Our initiatives encompass cutting-edge AI and machine
learning solutions designed to optimize decision-making, automate complex tasks, and enhance the
overall customer experience. With pioneering tools like [CodeAuto][20], we revolutionize the coding
process by reducing human effort and accelerating development timelines. By integrating AI into our
offerings, we empower businesses to achieve greater efficiency, foster innovation, and gain a
competitive edge in an increasingly digital world. Macrosoft has developed an AI Rationalization
framework that evaluates and optimizes the use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies within a
business, determining strategic solutions. Through continuous research and development, we ensure
our AI solutions remain at the forefront of technological advancements, adapting to evolving
industry needs. Our commitment to ethical AI practices guarantees transparency, accountability, and
trust in every solution we deliver.

[Explore More][21]

businesses by providing specialized technical talent. We offer a comprehensive range of staffing

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

End-to-End Visibility

### Track Every Delivery In Real Time, Whether Internal Or Outsourced

Monitor your entire delivery network from one one platform, see exactly where every order is, which
driver or courier has it, and when it'll arrive.

Track drivers live with real-time GPS visibility across your network so you can see exactly where
every driver is and how each route is progressing.

Capture complete proof of delivery with photos, signatures, and timestamps automatically shared with
customers.

Access unified analytics across all fleets and delivery partners to compare performance, identify
issues, and optimize your entire operation.

[Visibility]
Premium Customer Experience

### Keep Customers Informed And Engaged With Real-Time Updates

Send branded, automated notifications that always look like they’re coming from you, whether you
fulfill the order or outsource it.

Share live tracking pages where customers watch their delivery in real time, get AI-powered delay
alerts, and chat with drivers if needed.

Deliver instant proof of completion with photos and signatures automatically displayed on the
customer's tracking page, eliminating "where's my order?" calls.

Enable two-way chat between customers and drivers to clarify directions, confirm details, or resolve
issues before they impact delivery.

[Customer Experience]
AI Powered Delivery Automation

### Automate Routing And Dispatch With Real-Time AI Intelligence

Automatically optimize every route in real time using AI trained on 400M+ deliveries, continuously
adjusting for traffic, capacity, and time windows.

Use AI-Powered Auto-Dispatch to weave on-demand orders into active routes in real time, minimizing
disruptions and keeping deliveries on time.

Send accurate ETAs customers can trust, powered by AI that predicts delays and notifies customers
before issues escalate.

Use a 24/7 AI Support Assistant to get real-time guidance, resolve issues faster, and keep
day-to-day operations running smoothly.

[AI Automation]

### Tap Into a Network Of Vetted Couriers To Expand Delivery Capacity

Access 150+ courier partners across multiple delivery specialties through our Onfleet Connect
network.

# Design and deliver customer communications for digital, mobile and print

[
Learn more
][2]

# Rationalise, Simplify and Automate Customer Communications

# Quadient Inspire enables you to create and deliver personalised, compliant customer communications
# across all channels and all devices, from one centralised platform. It facilitates collaboration,
# integration, and connections that aren’t possible with disconnected project, line-of-business, or
# channel-based approaches.
# 
# Our powerful migration technology applies artificial intelligence, machine learning, and natural
# language processing to the time-consuming problem of retiring legacy customer communication
# systems, saving thousands of person-hours.

# Eliminate duplication of efforts across departments and channels

# Our cutting-edge migration tech, powered by AI, ML, and NLP, efficiently retires legacy CCM
# systems, saving thousands of person-hours.

# Migration simplification

# Our powerful migration technology uses artificial intelligence, machine learning, and natural
# language to remove thousands of person-hours from migration projects.

# One platform, unlimited channels

# Quadient Inspire, our leading customer communications management (CCM) platform, enables you to
# create and deliver personalised, compliant customer communications across all channels, from a
# single centralised platform.

# High return on maintenance (ROM)

# With major releases approximately every 20 months and the world’s largest CX-focused R&D team,
# Quadient consistently provides innovative solutions to meet customer needs and achieve CX
# transformation goals.

# Quadient Inspire Evolve

# Transform your customer experience overnight with a high-performance, SaaS customer communications
# solution from the world's most trusted CCM provider.

[
Learn more
][3]

# Transform in record time

# Accelerate your transformation within hours and engage your customers for swift success in today’s
# market.

# Scalable communications

# Send scalable communications on a cloud platform built for volume and compliance

# Reduce costs

# Safely design multichannel communications that are maintained by your lines of business, giving
# them control of the branding, content, and personalisation rules.

# Securely connect in-the-moment

# The on-demand service guarantees that your customers receive a personalised message at any time of
# the day or night, with speed and reliability.

# Quadient Inspire Flex

# The only fully integrated, any-premise enterprise CCM solution
# Inspire Flex enables organisations to create and deliver personalised, compliant customer
# communications across all channels, from one centralised platform.

[
Learn more
][4]

# Design

# Inspire Flex’s Designer UI offers the flexibility to create, personalise, manage and publish even
# the most complex and regulated communication templates.

# Customise

# Empower business users to manage content and personalisation in a controlled environment to ensure
# compliance.

# Produce

# Easily integrate multiple data sources to generate personalised digital and printed communications
# on demand or in high-volume batches.

# Deliver

# Deliver email, SMS and Whatsapp messages and empower your users to manage channel preference
# rules.

# Transform to digital

# Integrate communications into your digital platforms for responsive forms that adapt for optimised
# viewing automatically.

# Managed services

# Quadient Managed Services (QMS) gives customers the full power of Inspire Flex, while removing the
# hassle of managing the application or its hosted infrastructure.

Most platforms can't. Respond.io unifies all customer touchpoints and CRMs in a team inbox with AI
Agents and native lead management so your conversations never break — even when customers switch
channels. 
[Talk to Sales][78][Start Free Trial][79]
[g2 image]

Top-rated on G2 for highest ROI

## **Explore the Power of Respond.io**

Sell smarter, strengthen relationships, and respond faster. All from one inbox. Experience it
instantly, no sign-up needed.

## Scale business growth with every customer conversation

As chats and calls multiply, old inboxes and workflows break. Respond.io’s Conversation-Led Growth™
framework helps you manage the entire customer journey across every channel in one place, even at
high volume.

### Capture: Unify customer touch points to drive revenue

**Leads come from everywhere** — WhatsApp chats, TikTok ads, Facebook messages or even store visits.
Respond.io unifies them in a team inbox so no opportunity is overlooked. Work with clean, organized
profiles that sync with your CRMs so every new interaction is ready for fast follow-up.

### Convert: Sell more with AI and analytics

**When conversations increase, priorities get lost.** Let AI Agents answer enquiries and qualify
leads so your team focuses on customers ready to buy. Switch from chats to calls at a click,
automate bookings and shorten sales journeys with smart routing and collaboration. Built-in
analytics make it clear which ads, agents and channels drive ROI.

### Retain: Build recurring revenue, not just one-time sales

**Acquiring customers is costly** — keeping them fuels sustainable growth. With full context at your
fingertips, every follow-up feels personal, from targeted broadcasts and renewal reminders to
in-chat CSAT surveys. Paired with 99.999% uptime, earn a reputation for reliability that turns
one-time buyers into repeat customers.

## Chats, calls and emails in one thread

Respond.io unifies **WhatsApp Business Calls, Messenger Calls and VoIP** in the same thread as your
messages and emails.



It also connects with your CRM for full customer context in every conversation. No more silos or
juggling multiple platforms; just one reliable record for every customer, no matter the channel.

## AI built on a trusted foundation

Scale without adding headcount. Accelerate growth on every channel with AI Agents that respond,
route and perform tasks accurately and reliably.

[

Try AI Agent for free

][81]
[Play Video]

I'm Jerry, founder and CEO of respond.io AI is changing the way businesses talk to customers. People
want instant answers without losing reliability or quality. That's why respond.io is making customer
communications truly agentic. with AI agents that can understand, decide and act. This is not AI for
the sake of it. It’s purpose built to scale customer conversations into meaningful and measurable
ways. respond.io is already the backbone for billions of conversations powering global businesses
and trusted by partners like Meta, TikTok, and many more AI agents expand your ability to turn
conversations into revenue. They can handle routine task or guide entire customer journeys by
answering complex questions, updating your CRM, recommending products, booking appointments, and
more. All across the channels your customers love and the tools that you rely on. This is
intelligence that works 24/7 Even as you watch this, our AI agents are handling millions of
conversations on their own, freeing teams to focus on critical and high value conversations. With
respond.io you get AI agents to help you capture, convert, and retain customers at scale on a
platform that is reliable, secure, and backed by exceptional customer support. And this is just the
start.

### Convert customers efficiently

Multilingual AI Agents handle ad enquiries, answer FAQs and route only serious buyers to your team
for faster conversions and higher marketing ROI.

### Shorten sales cycles

Turn intent into purchases by removing friction. AI Agents recommend products, manage bookings and
share payment details for seamless customer journeys.

### Launch quickly and securely

Handle 10x more customers autonomously with advanced reasoning, high accuracy and built-in
guardrails. Start quickly with AI Agent templates or customize one to your needs.

## Scale business growth with every customer conversation

As chats and calls multiply, old inboxes and workflows break. Respond.io’s Conversation-Led Growth™
framework helps you manage the entire customer journey across every channel in one place, even at
high volume.

### Capture: Unify customer touch points to drive revenue

**Leads come from everywhere** — WhatsApp chats, TikTok ads, Facebook messages or even store visits.
Respond.io unifies them in a team inbox so no opportunity is overlooked. Work with clean, organized
profiles that sync with your CRMs so every new interaction is ready for fast follow-up.

### Convert: Sell more with AI and analytics

**When conversations increase, priorities get lost.** Let AI Agents answer enquiries and qualify
leads so your team focuses on customers ready to buy. Switch from chats to calls at a click,
automate bookings and shorten sales journeys with smart routing and collaboration. Built-in
analytics make it clear which ads, agents and channels drive ROI.

### Retain: Build recurring revenue, not just one-time sales

**Acquiring customers is costly** — keeping them fuels sustainable growth. With full context at your
fingertips, every follow-up feels personal, from targeted broadcasts and renewal reminders to
in-chat CSAT surveys. Paired with 99.999% uptime, earn a reputation for reliability that turns
one-time buyers into repeat customers.

Respond.io unifies **WhatsApp Business Calls, Messenger Calls and VoIP** in the same thread as your
messages and emails.



It also connects with your CRM for full customer context in every conversation. No more silos or
juggling multiple platforms; just one reliable record for every customer, no matter the channel.

## Establish efficient customer communication in key business areas

Enhance your client relations throughout the entire funnel, from a first contact to repeat
purchases.
* [Marketing] **Marketing**
  
  Bulk messaging, notifications, order updates, lead nurturing, and more
* [Sales] **Sales**
  
  Request distribution from a variety of messengers and conversion of customers into buyers
* [Security] **Support**
  
  Handle claims and tickets from various channels, manage the speed and quality of the customer
  support and much more
* [Support] **Security**
  
  Leverage Two-Factor Authentication via instant messengers. Log user activity and save chat records

[Umnico logo]  —  **customer communication management software**

We have designed Umnico to facilitate customer communication, reduce response time and the
engagement costs. The service is useful both for a small ecommerce business and for an enterprise.

Test all the Umnico omnichannel sales communication platform features today to maximize your
business profit tomorrow.

[Sign Up Free ][47][Design your rate][48]

**5,000+** users who trust us

**> 35 M** messages a month

**over 25** communication channels

[[Umnico demonstration]][49]

## Use all instant messengers and social media in one chat center

Communicate with your customers through one application, using all modern communication platforms,
such as Facebook*, WhatsApp, Telegram, Viber, VK, live chat center, and other social media.

Engage your client in messengers they trust. Stop wasting time switching between multiple tabs, and
getting lost in chat centers and dialogues.

[Umnico channels]
[Communication automation settings & chatbot builder in Umnico]

## Automate customer inquiries processing

Automatic distribution of inquiries among employees, use message templates, hotkeys for quick
replies, and chatbots for processing frequent questions — these Umnico features allow you to spend
less time on routine and stay focused on strategic tasks. With this omnichannel customer
communication management system, messages from all channels are displayed in a single interface and
saved even after business hours. You won’t miss a single inquiry from a customer. You can also set
up automated responses in the live chat widget for the website and instant messengers, improving
your overall customer communication management.

[Communication automation settings & chatbot builder in Umnico]
[Sales funnel in Umnico Inbox]

## Increase the conversion rate by improving the efficiency of inquiries processing

Use Umnico to enhance your customer communication:
* Leverage digital pipeline
* Set up message notifications
* Robotise answering to frequently asked questions
* Track dialogue sources
* Distribute leads among your staff
* Export your customer database for further analysis and import

[Try it now for free][50]
[Dialogues in Umnico]

## Let your employees sell more with the CCM software

Umnico makes it possible to build omnichannel communication with clients by bringing all channels
into a single window of the customer communication management app. You can reach your customers
where it is convenient for them, increase the speed and quality of their inquiries processing,
improve the loyalty rate and exceed sales volume limits.

Connect all communication channels suitable for your business to engage more customers at the right
moment with a right message.

**Your customers prefer messengers!**

Interact with them in their convenient environment. Check out all Umnico features right away

[Sign up free][51]
[Instant messenger users]
[Chat records and client cards in Umnico]

## Make your client communication safer

Take control of correspondence in messengers and social media, and store customer details and chats
in a reliable system, without risking data leakage or loss.
* Quick access to all correspondence between agents and customers
* An employee cannot download the database, and customer contact details can be hidden from them
* No need to provide managers with direct access to the company’s accounts on social media and
  messengers
* The customer base cannot be stolen or contacted by bypassing the customer conversation platform

Correspondence with clients is stored in Umnico, and not on employees’ personal devices, and is
available to managers in accordance with customizable access rights. Employees will only see and
work with the information they need. You can restrict access to certain contacts, conversations, and
integrations.

[Communication performance analytics in Umnico]

## Strengthen control over performance with chat analytics

With the sales pipeline, you can effectively monitor the work of your employees.
* Track the number of inquiries processed and the quality of replies for each agent
* Calculate employee motivation and bonuses based on convenient reports
* Identify at what stages of the sales pipeline customers churn

Umnico omnichannel messaging platform provides you with all the necessary tools to accurately assess
the quality of customer service, calculate incentives, and analyze weak points in customer
communication.

## Deploy Umnico on your servers 🔐🗄️

The On-Premise solution or Self-Hosted version of the omnichannel customer communication management
platform Umnico is a variant of the cloud service of this chat center that runs locally - on the
premises of your organization rather than our remote facility. This version delivers the highest
level of security and corporate data safety, though it requires additional maintenance resources.
Payment for the on-premise version is made as a one-time fee, with the customer company being
empowered to independently install and maintain the software.

Earn more with Umnico's partnership program. Welcome and connect new users to Umnico customer
communication management software to resell the subscription with a discount or get a commission
based on their payments.

## FAQ

Everything you need to know about Voxys Connect and how it fits your business.

[Contact us][22]
What is Voxys Connect?
Voxys Connect is an AI-powered customer communication platform for modern businesses. It unifies
WhatsApp, Email, SMS, Voice, Instagram, Telegram, and Web Chat into one inbox, with Captain AI
handling routing, summaries, and sentiment analysis across all channels.
Do you support the WhatsApp Business API?
Yes. We handle full WhatsApp Business API integration, including message templates, media support,
and broadcast campaigns. Setup takes minutes and we manage all compliance requirements for you.
How many languages do you support?
Captain AI handles 50+ languages out of the box — detecting language, tone, and context
automatically, and replying in the customer's language with the same accuracy as English.
Multilingual support is built in from the ground up, not an afterthought.
Can I self-host Voxys Connect?
We offer both cloud and self-hosted deployment options. Self-hosting gives you full control over
your data and infrastructure. Contact our team to discuss which option fits your security
requirements.
How quickly can we go live?
Most businesses launch their first channel within hours. The flow builder is intuitive, channel
connections are straightforward, and Captain AI starts learning immediately. We've seen teams go
from signup to handling live conversations in a single day.

What is Voxys Connect?
Voxys Connect is an AI-powered customer communication platform for modern businesses. It unifies
WhatsApp, Email, SMS, Voice, Instagram, Telegram, and Web Chat into one inbox, with Captain AI
handling routing, summaries, and sentiment analysis across all channels.
Do you support the WhatsApp Business API?
Yes. We handle full WhatsApp Business API integration, including message templates, media support,
and broadcast campaigns. Setup takes minutes and we manage all compliance requirements for you.
How many languages do you support?
Captain AI handles 50+ languages out of the box — detecting language, tone, and context
automatically, and replying in the customer's language with the same accuracy as English.
Multilingual support is built in from the ground up, not an afterthought.
Can I self-host Voxys Connect?
We offer both cloud and self-hosted deployment options. Self-hosting gives you full control over
your data and infrastructure. Contact our team to discuss which option fits your security
requirements.
How quickly can we go live?
Most businesses launch their first channel within hours. The flow builder is intuitive, channel
connections are straightforward, and Captain AI starts learning immediately. We've seen teams go
from signup to handling live conversations in a single day.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to common questions about WA Sender

Is WA Sender safe to use? Will my WhatsApp account get banned?

WA Sender is designed with safety in mind. Our smart delay system, batch sending, and gradual volume
increase features help protect your account. We recommend following WhatsApp's guidelines and
avoiding spam messages.

What's the difference between the plans?

All plans include the full WA Sender software with unlimited features. The Personal plan is for
individual use. The Reseller plan adds an unlimited online panel to generate licenses for your
clients. The Distributor plan lets you create multiple resellers, each with their own panel.

Do I need to save contacts before sending messages?

No! WA Sender allows you to send messages to unsaved numbers directly. Simply import your contact
list from CSV/Excel or paste the numbers, and you're ready to go.

Is this a one-time payment?

Yes! All our plans are anuallicenses with one-time payment. No monthly fees, no hidden costs. You
pay once and use forever, including all future updates.

Can I send media files with messages?

Yes! WA Sender supports sending images, videos, documents, and audio files. You can attach media to
make your messages more engaging and informative.

  leadership programs, team sports and camps.

  lives. The Y also collaborates with community leaders to bring healthy living within reach of all
  people.

## Our Impact

Each year, we strive to transform lives and strengthen communities worldwide.
* ### 18 million community members served annually
  
  Across the U.S., our Ys reach millions of people in 10,000 communities.
* ### 2.4 million youths served in food programs
  
  We provide millions of pounds of groceries to families each month.
* ### 244,000 overnight camp participants
  
  Our day and overnight camps empowered kids by building lifelong skills, confidence and
  friendships.
* ### 2,597 Ys across the U.S.
  
  Ys reach millions of people across 50 states, plus the District of Columbia and Puerto Rico.

For 25 years, we've helped organizations like yours solve their toughest business challenges with
the power of effective and strategic internal, leadership, culture, and change communications. When
you partner with us you work with a deeply experienced team who applies our diverse and collective
experience to help you achieve your goals.

## Honored as 2025 Agency of the Year — Twice

In our 25th year, The Grossman Group is proud to be recognized by both PRSA’s Silver Anvil Awards
and Ragan’s Zenith Awards for excellence in communications.

Learn our origin story and discover what sets the firm apart as we celebrate 25 years as an agency.

## Solutions for the Short & Long Term

As a leading internal communication consultancy, The Grossman Group provides you with solutions for
quick wins and results, as well as effective long-term solutions through employee communications.
* **Internal Communication**
  
  ### Speak to the Right Stakeholders at the Right Time
  
  As a leading internal communications agency, we help you synthesize and deliver your message to
  all stakeholders in a way that drives employee engagement, increases productivity, accelerates
  business results, and minimizes the downside of change.
  
  [[Explore Internal Communications Solutions]][52]
* **Leadership Communication**
  
  ### Communicate Effectively to Drive Strategy
  
  We help you articulate your strategy and equip your team to execute it. From changes in executive
  leadership and organizational transformation to culture change, we understand the intricacies of
  communicating complex messages to diverse stakeholders. We help you deliver clear, effective
  messages that drive the action you seek.
  
  [[Improve Leadership Communications]][53]

  ### Transform with Purpose
  
  As an internal communications agency, we’re experts at helping you successfully navigate change,
  align stakeholders on the vision for the future, and prepare leaders to communicate complex
  organizational, strategic, and operational transformation in a way that drives results.
  
  [[Communicate Change With Intention]][54]

  ### Evolve Confidently, See Results
  
  Change is inevitable. At The Grossman Group, we have the experience and methodologies to help you
  evolve your culture in a focused and positive way that allows you to deliver on your strategy
  while creating a better workplace.
  
  [[Drive Organizational Culture Change]][55]

  strategies they need today to be even more effective in their roles.

experience to help you achieve your goals.
